Cost: 7,500eb (Luxury)
Class: Excellent Quality Crossbow
Range: Longbow
Pre-installed: Long Limbs, Magrail Kit (w/ C-Thru, Headtoll), Smart Scope [w/ Opti-Zoom & Stalker Optics], Reinforced String, Sling, TUp (Optimized Rebuild [-1 Slot]) Tech Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

While charged, its Tech Rebuild shows rough target outlines through one layer of Thin or Thick Cover (Stalker Optics) and can fire through it (C-Thru). Aimed Shots deal +1d6 (6d6) (Headtoll).

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
